== Overview ==
[[File:Bessho Suwa Jinja Keidai.jpg|thumb|Shrine grounds of Suwa Shrine|250px]]
The date of establishment is unknown, but there exists a {{ill|Munafuda|ja|棟札|zh|上樑記牌|qid=Q8008834}} (ridgepole inscription) dating from {{ill|Tenshō (Momoyama period)|ckb|تێنشۆ (سەردەمی مۆمۆیاما)|fa|تنشو|fr|Ère Tenshō (Momoyama)|ja|天正|ko|덴쇼 (아즈치모모야마 시대)|ro|Era Tenshō (Momoyama)|ru|Тэнсё (Адзути-Момояма)|simple|Tenshō (Momoyama period)|sr|Теншо (Момојама период)|sv|Tenshō|tr|Tenshō (Momoyama)|zh|天正 (日本)|qid=Q1145058}} 12{{sfn|Ashida, ed.|1930|p=272}}. There is a theory identifying this shrine with the “Izumo no Yashiro” recorded in the {{ill|Izumo no Kuni Fudoki|de|Izumo Fudoki|ja|出雲国風土記|simple|Izumo-no-Kuni Fudoki|zh|出雲國風土記|qid=Q11395858}} and the “{{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Izumo Shrine}}” listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932}}{{sfn|Ashida, ed.|1930|p=272}}, but there are multiple candidate shrines for Izumo no Yashiro / Izumo Shrine, and criticism of the Suwa Shrine theory is strong{{sfn|Ishizuka|1986|pp=156–189}}.

In {{ill|Meiji era|ar|فترة مييجي|ast|Dómina Meiji|az|Meydzi dövrü|azb|مئی‌جی دؤورو|be|Перыяд Мэйдзі|bn|মেইজি যুগ|bo|མེའི་ཇིའི་དུས་དུས་མཚམས།|ca|Era Meiji|ceb|Panahon sa Meiji|cs|Období Meidži|da|Meiji-perioden|de|Meiji-Zeit|el|Μεϊτζί (περίοδος)|es|Era Meiji|et|Meiji periood|eu|Meiji Aroa|fa|دوره میجی|fi|Meiji-kausi|fr|Ère Meiji|gl|Período Meiji|he|תקופת מייג'י|hr|Meiji (razdoblje)|ht|Epòk Meiji|hu|Meidzsi-kor|id|Zaman Meiji|io|Ero Meiji|is|Meiji-tímabilið|it|Periodo Meiji|ja|明治|ka|მეიძის ეპოქა|kbp|Mejii wɛɛ yaa alɩwaatʊ|kk|Мэйдзи дәуірі|ko|메이지 시대|la|Aetas Meiji|lt|Meidži laikotarpis|lv|Meidzi periods|mk|Меиџи (период)|mn|Мэйжийн эрин|ms|Zaman Meiji|nl|Meijiperiode|nn|Meiji|no|Meiji-perioden|pl|Meiji (okres)|pt|Era Meiji|ro|Perioada Meiji|ru|Мэйдзи|simple|Meiji period|sk|Obdobie Meidži|sq|Periudha Meixhi|sr|Меиџи период|sv|Meijiperioden|ta|மெய்சி காலம்|th|ยุคเมจิ|tl|Panahong Meiji|tr|Meiji Dönemi|uk|Період Мейдзі|ur|میجی دور|vi|Thời kỳ Minh Trị|war|Panahon Meiji|wuu|明治|zh|明治|zh_classical|明治|zh_min_nan|Bêng-tī|zh_yue|明治|qid=Q3125096}} 5 (1872), it was designated a village shrine{{sfn|Takahashi|1983|p=515}}.

== Enshrined deities ==
'''{{ill|Takeminakata|es|Takeminakata|hu|Takeminakata|id|Takeminakata|it|Takeminakata|ja|タケミナカタ|mni|ꯇꯀꯦꯃꯤꯅꯀꯇ|pl|Takeminakata|zh|建御名方神|qid=Q9150391|lt=Takeminakata-no-Kami}}'''
:According to the 18th-century topographical work {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Unyōshi}}, there was a rock cliff more than 40 ken high on Mount Miya, and beside it a round standing rock about 30 ken high and roughly 5 jō in circumference, called “Hobashira-ishi” or “{{ruby|檣|kachi|rp1=[|rp2=]}}-ishi”{{sfn|Ashida, ed.|1930|p=272}}{{efn|The Hobashira-ishi no longer exists{{sfn|Shimane Prefectural Shrine Association}}.}}. There is a tradition that when the monk Chishun, who founded {{ill|Gakuen-ji|ja|鰐淵寺|qid=Q11674322}} located near Suwa Shrine, came from {{ill|Shinano Province|ckb|پارێزگای شینانۆ|cs|Provincie Šinano|de|Provinz Shinano|eo|Provinco Ŝinano|es|Provincia de Shinano|fa|ولایت شینانو|fr|Province de Shinano|gl|Provincia de Shinano|hak|Shinano-koet|id|Provinsi Shinano|it|Shinano (provincia)|ja|信濃国|knc|Shinano Province|ko|시나노국|lt|Šinano žemė|ms|Wilayah Shinano|nl|Shinano (provincie)|pl|Prowincja Shinano|pt|Província de Shinano|ru|Синано (провинция)|simple|Shinano Province|sk|Šinano (provincia)|sr|Провинција Шинано|th|แคว้นชินาโนะ|tr|Shinano (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Сінано|zh|信濃國|zh_min_nan|Sinano-kok|zh_yue|信濃國|qid=Q289250}}, three old men welcomed him by boat and then divided the ship’s fittings and flew off to three places{{sfn|Ashida, ed.|1930|p=272}}. One of them was Suwa Myōjin; the fitting he took was the mast, which is said to be the Hobashira-ishi{{sfn|Ashida, ed.|1930|p=272}}.

'''{{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Yatsukamizuomitsuno-no-Mikoto}}'''
:The {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Unyōshi}} states “it is Takeminakata-no-Mikoto,” and does not list Yatsukamizuomitsuno-no-Mikoto{{sfn|Ashida, ed.|1930|p=271}}.
